plants.plant_name: HBIS Laoting Iron & Steel Co., Ltd. (Tangshan New District, Tangshan, Hebei)

carbon_intensity.methodology_notes: Company-level EI used if needed; not available for plant

plants.plant_name: HBIS Wugang Special Plate Co., Ltd. (Wugang, Henan)

risk_factors.market_risk: Cyclical demand for heavy plates, competition
risk_factors.operational_risk: Major heavy equipment maintenance, high energy use
